title: Wire a production producer of receipted prompts: the prompt-delivery receipt module is dormant outside tests
outcome: Wire a production producer of receipted prompts: the prompt-delivery receipt module is dormant outside tests
acceptance: At least one production path that dispatches host-originated prompts (for example orchestrator or mailbox wakes) enqueues them through queue_receipted_orchestrator_prompt_on_record, so prompt_deliveries is populated outside tests and the cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code)) on the receipt impl can be removed.
Requeue of a rejected receipt (requeue_rejected_prompt_delivery) has a production caller or is explicitly documented as operator-only, and PROMPT_DELIVERY_WRITE_AHEAD_BUDGET is used outside tests.
